name: Good Dog Club T-Shirt
description: A soft, breathable cotton T-shirt for your pup. Features the iconic 'Good Dog Club' paw print design. Available in sizes XS-XL. Machine washable.

name: Paw & Found Logo Tee
description: Rep your favorite pet store with our signature logo tee. Lightweight, tagless, and super soft — perfect for daily walks. Available in 5 colors.

name: Adventure Pup Graphic Tee
description: A playful graphic tee featuring a mountain adventure scene. Made from 100% organic cotton with a comfortable oversized fit. Your dog will look ready for any trail.

name: Classic Plaid Bandana
description: A timeless plaid bandana that adds instant style. Double-sided design, soft cotton, and easy slip-on loop. One size fits most dogs and cats.

name: Cozy Hoodie Pullover
description: Keep your pup warm and stylish with our fleece-lined hoodie. Features a functional hood, front pocket, and adjustable chest strap. Perfect for chilly morning walks.

name: Stainless Steel Bowl Set
description: A durable 2-bowl set (food + water) with non-slip silicone base. Rust-resistant, dishwasher-safe, and available in 3 sizes. No more sliding bowls!

name: Nylon Reflective Leash
description: A sturdy 6-foot leash with reflective stitching for night visibility. Padded handle for comfort, strong clip. Available in 6 colors. Built to last.

name: Adjustable Collar (Leather)
description: Full-grain leather collar with brushed nickel hardware. Adjustable from 10-16 inches. Hand-stitched and built to patina beautifully over time. Includes D-ring for tags.

name: Squeaky Tennis Ball 3-Pack
description: Extra-durable tennis balls with built-in squeakers. Non-toxic, felt-covered, and designed to withstand enthusiastic fetch sessions. Bright neon colors for easy spotting.

name: Plush Squeaky Fox Toy
description: An ultra-soft plush fox with hidden squeaker and crinkle paper inside. Double-stitched seams for durability. Perfect for cuddling and play. Machine washable.

name: Premium Clumping Cat Litter (40lb)
description: Superior clumping cat litter made from natural clay. 99.9% dust-free, odor-locking technology keeps your home fresh. One 40lb bag lasts up to 30 days for one cat. Unscented.

name: Eco-Friendly Poop Bags (120ct)
description: Plant-based, compostable poop bags that are strong and leak-proof. Each roll has 15 bags, 8 rolls per pack. Lavender-scented to mask odors. Certified compostable.

name: Slicker Grooming Brush
description: Professional-grade slicker brush with fine bent wires that gently remove mats, tangles, and loose fur. Ergonomic non-slip handle. Suitable for all coat types.

name: Gentle Pet Shampoo (16oz)
description: Oatmeal and aloe vera formula that soothes dry, itchy skin while leaving coats soft and shiny. Tearless, pH-balanced, and free from parabens and sulfates.

name: Personalized Engraved ID Tag
description: Stainless steel ID tag with deep engraving that won't fade. Includes your pet's name and your phone number. Choose from bone, circle, or heart shape. Comes with a split ring.

name: Ventilated Travel Carrier
description: A lightweight, airline-approved pet carrier with mesh ventilation on all sides. Padded shoulder strap, fleece bedding, and secure zipper closures. Fits pets up to 15 lbs.

name: Orthopedic Pet Bed (Medium)
description: Memory foam pet bed with a washable, plush cover. Raised rim for head and neck support. Non-slip bottom. Medium size fits dogs up to 45 lbs. Available in 3 colors.
